The 2nd Cohort of Solve Ambassadors: Meet AKQUA GEL from the U.S.
AKQUA GEL is a smart bandage that helps monitor wound healing.

It tracks temperature changes, helps identify signs of infection, and connects patients with doctors through real-time data and chat support.

Combining care and technology, AKQUA GEL aims to support healthcare access, especially in settings with limited medical staff.

Watch to see how this Top 10 Global Ambassador solution heals with innovation.
